context: Adds a CancellationToken parameter so callers can cancel long-running order lookups. The endpoint has a 30-second timeout.
explanation: The CancellationToken is accepted but never passed to any of the four downstream async calls — cancellation has no effect and the database queries keep running after the caller times out. Fix: pass ct to every awaited async method (e.g. GetByIdAsync(orderId, ct)).
